images.caption: Figure 1:Illustration of collaborative autoresearch.Sixteen research agents with diverse scientific backgrounds collaborate on linear attention architecture search. Starting from Gated DeltaNet-2 (GDN2), the team discovers Context-First DeltaNet (CFDN), which improves performance across language modeling, common-sense reasoning, and synthetic and real-world retrieval tasks.

Figure 2:Organization of the autonomous research team.(a)Sixteen researchers have distinct scientific backgrounds and persistent individual histories. Adaptive selection balances measured contributions with opportunities for less-tested researchers.(b)A selected researcher develops one proposal through review and, if approved, implementation and experimentation, then reflects on its outcome.(c)Proposals, outcomes, and their relationships form a shared body of knowledge through which researchers build on one another’s work. Circled numbers identify the four organizational factors studied in our comparisons.
